name: roundtrip
description: A recording decodes to its frames and encodes back to the same bytes, in its two files: the .ttyrec is classic ttyrec — little-endian [sec u32][usec u32][len u32], then the data — and the .dir sidecar holds one code per frame, 0 for output and 1 for input. One recording per session, input and output in it. This one belongs to a session still live when it was read, so it has no end marker. Every collected recording must parse to its last byte — a torn tail, or a sidecar that does not count the frames, is a failure.
